item.title: From IL-23/IL-17 to GM-CSF: how is the immuno-inflammatory continuum reshaped in spondyloarthritis?
item.description: Frontiers in immunology - Review - Spondyloarthritis (SpA) encompasses axial SpA/ankylosing spondylitis, psoriatic arthritis, reactive arthritis, and inflammatory bowel disease-associated arthritis, unified by entheseal inflammation...
